newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms buy 22,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms buy 22,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp said on Friday they had bought a total of 22,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp.
Officials at the two companies confirmed the deals but declined to elaborate.

Cheiljedang bought 13,000 tonnes at basis over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said. Shipment was set for January 10-February 10 from the Pacific Northwest to the western port city of Inchon.
